remarksWeb: The Company had 4 ESOP schemes namely PSP-1, PSP-2, ESOP-2016 and ESOP-2019. Out of the 4 schemes, the Company has formally closed PSP-1 and PSP-2 on account of completion of granting, vesting and exercise of eligible stock options entirely. Further, the Company has also formally closed ESOP-2016 for further grant of options, however, the eligible employees continue to exercise vested options under the scheme. ESOP-2019 is operational for granting, vesting, exercise and re-issue of lapsed options.

In furtherance to the same an application was made to Stock Exchanges, which was approved on 21st December, 2022, following which MacRitchie Investments Pte. Ltd and Seletar Investments Pte Ltd.
